description: Fifteen pinned ViewGroup executions replayed per pinned module: ViewGroupObjectArrayEvent (ord 0) object-array events over groupwin(p1)#length(2) pinning the per-group sum(p2) Long evolution 10/21/33/36 through istream-only listener records, ViewGroupLengthWin (ord 14) groupwin(theString)#length(3) pinning istream-only delivery until each group window fills then irstream pairs evicting E2/20 and E1/1, ViewGroupStats (ord 1) four separate @name'd select-* deployments over groupwin(symbol) with #length(3)#uni and #uni price/volume variants pinning per-send single-row averages per statement plus the ordered priceAllStats/priceLast3Stats iterator snapshots, ViewGroupCorrel (ord 4) and ViewGroupLinest (ord 5) select-* per-group derived-value rows over length(1000000) with NaN rendered as the {state:nan} marker, ViewGroupMultiProperty (ord 6) groupwin(symbol, feed, volume)#uni(price) irstream datapoint pairs plus the ordered iterator snapshot, and five virtual-time grouped-window executions driven entirely by advance-time steps: ViewGroupTimeBatch (ord 10) and ViewGroupTimeLengthBatch (ord 13) with identical timelines pinning silenced sends then group flushes new 10/20 at 11000 and new 30 at 20000 plus the 21000 empty re-arm that still posts old 10/20, ViewGroupTimeAccum (ord 11) pinning istream inserts then delayed flushes old 10/20 at 15000 and old 30 at 20000, ViewGroupTimeOrder (ord 12) over SupportBeanTimestamp#groupwin(groupId)#time_order(timestamp, 10 sec) releasing E2 at 12000 and E4 at 12500 while E1 and E3 expire unobserved, and ViewGroupTimeWin (ord 16) pinning per-group expiries old 10, old 20, old 30 at 11000/15000/20000; suite milestones record nothing, every ord-1 listener invocation carries exactly the asserted last-new row because each send updates one group, AnyOrder iterator assertions stay unpinned, and the suite's pre-deploy advanceTime(1000) replays as each case's leading advance-time step because grouped time windows anchor on the first event, and three reclaim-group executions observed through recorded schedule and iterator counts: ViewGroupReclaimTimeWindow (ord 2) pinning 10 scheduled per-group time-window handles then 1 after the 1000-second advance reclaims the aged groups, followed by an explicit undeploy-all step and a zero overall schedule count, ViewGroupReclaimAgedHint (ord 3) sending one thousand events per one-second slot for ten slots and observing 6000 retained keepall rows then 6001 after one more E0 send, and ViewGroupReclaimWithFlipTime (ord 9) observing keepall counts 1, 2, and 2 across sends at 0, 4999, and 5000 where the reclaim flip drops group E1; the three reclaim cases record no listener deliveries because the suite pins only counts there, every count record carries the observed value without time or sequence, and the suites pre-deploy advanceTime(0) replays through each cases initialization advance to epoch 0, and one further listener-recorded execution, ViewGroupExpressionGrouped (ord 17) over SupportBeanTimestamp#groupwin(timestamp.getDayOfWeek())#length(2) sending the suite's two-arg-constructor events E1/E2/E3 at 2002-01-01/08/15T09:00:00.000 (the lenient 2002-01-015T09:0:00.000 parse) with null groupId, pinning istream inserts for E1 and E2 then E3 evicting E1 as the single flattened old row the suite asserts
